command.generate.title: AI Commit Generator: Generate Commit Message from Staged Changes
command.selectApiBaseUrl.title: AI Commit Generator: Select API Base URL (Custom Input Supported)
config.title: AI Commit
config.apiBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible API. Enter a URL directly, or run 'AI Commit Generator: Select API Base URL' to choose OpenAI, Kimi, DeepSeek, GLM, Ollama, or a custom URL.
config.apiKey.description: Your API key for the configured endpoint
config.model.description: Model name to use (e.g. deepseek-chat, claude-opus-4-6, gpt-4o)
config.systemPrompt.description: System prompt sent to the LLM. Customize this to match your commit message format.
config.maxDiffChars.description: Maximum diff characters to send to the API. Excess will be truncated.
config.temperature.description: AI generation temperature (0-2). Lower is more stable. Default: 0.3. Set to -1 to omit the parameter (for models with a fixed temperature).
config.gitPath.description: Path to git executable. Change this if git is not in your PATH (e.g. C:\Program Files\Git\bin\git.exe)
